subject: Offer coordination and comp exception request — René Ortega

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Debrief: René Ortega — Sr. Inference Engineer

Markus,

Quick debrief from this morning's loop: René is a strong systems-focused inference engineer — heavy production experience (LLM runtimes, KV cache work) and shipped latency improvements at scale. Interviewers (ML infra + serving runtime + product) were aligned on technical competency and cross-team collaboration. A few notes:

- Strengths: memory/kv cache optimization, CUDA-aware inference tuning, pragmatic rollout experience.
- Open question: limited direct hiring/mentorship examples but definitely a solid IC3->IC4 ramp candidate.
- Red flags: none significant; compensation is the primary gate.

Recommendation: move to offer. Suggested level: IC3 (with stretch to IC3+) based on impact and the need for senior infra ownership. Recommended target comp (market-backed): base $200,000, 30k sign-on, equity 0.25% (4-yr, 1-yr cliff). Resume attached.

If you want, I can draft the candidate-facing summary for Marissa/TA.

— Jonas

Attachments: rene_ortega_resume.pdf
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Subject: Request: comp exception & sign-off for René Ortega (CAND-2026-089)

Marissa / Lauren —

Following Jonas' debrief, I'm requesting an approval path to issue an offer to René Ortega. Fast facts: strong hire, immediate product impact potential. Proposed package:

- Base salary: $200,000
- One-time sign-on: $30,000
- Equity: 0.25% (standard grant template)
- Level: IC3 (exception to allow IC3+ comp positioning if needed)

Per our banding, $200k is slightly above IC3 midpoint. Given market pressure for inference talent, would like an exception to place at the top of IC3 band (or IC3+ if we can justify). Please see attached comp_worksheet.xlsx and Jonas' resume.

Timelines: candidate expects verbal this week; would appreciate a decision by EOD Friday so TA can proceed with verbal. If you need any more context or a quantified business case, I can provide it.

Thanks — Markus
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Hi Markus / Lauren —

Attached is a short comp analysis (comp_analysis_rene.xlsx) and market benchmarks for inference engineering (market_benchmarks_q3_2026.pdf). Summary:

- Market: Top-of-market for Sr. inference IC3 in SF Bay commonly spans $190k–$215k base depending on equity and sign-on.
- Our bands: IC3 midpoint is $175k; top-of-band ~195k.
- Recommendation: Approve a stretch offer at $210,000 base (authorized as an exception), 30k sign-on, 0.25% equity. Rationale: speed to hire + candidate's unique runtime experience.

HR notes: If leadership approves the exception, TA will prepare a verbal and move to written offer. We will need legal review of the equity schedule and standard background checks.

I have populated the worksheet (comp_worksheet.xlsx) with breakdowns and suggested approvals. If Lauren signs off, I can finalize and route to Legal for the equity language.

— Marissa
